config.title: FUNDA — Invoice Line-Items Builder

intro.title: FUNDA — Invoice Line-Items Builder
intro.body: In this lesson you will build an Invoice Line-Items Builder — a dynamic form where users can add, remove, and reorder product rows, each with a name, quantity, unit price, and computed line total. The invoice automatically sums all rows into a grand total. You will manage the rows as a FormArray of FormGroups, add and remove controls programmatically, derive computed totals from valueChanges, and apply cross-field validation (e.g., total must not exceed a credit limit). TypedForms (Angular 14+) give you full type safety across the entire form model.
intro.usecase: Dynamic line-item forms appear in invoicing tools, order management systems, expense reports, CRM quote builders, and procurement platforms. They are among the most complex UI patterns in enterprise Angular apps.

objectives: Create a typed FormArray of FormGroups using FormBuilder and Angular 14's strictly-typed form APIs
Implement addItem() and removeItem(index) methods that mutate the FormArray programmatically
Subscribe to valueChanges on the FormArray to compute and display a live running total without manual event handlers
Write a cross-field validator on the parent FormGroup that compares the total against a maximum allowed amount
Render each FormGroup row using formGroupName and formControlName directives with *ngFor and trackBy
Mark individual row controls as touched when the user tries to submit, triggering per-row error messages
Patch an existing invoice from an API response into the FormArray using patchValue and setControl
